profile.headline: Software Engineer at Coupang
profile.summary:
I highly value creating work I am proud of and enjoy finding simple solutions to complex problems.

I also enjoy making work fun.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Staff Software Engineer (1 year)
Jobs Collections and new DASH modeling architecture for Jobs Pillar
Data Model Committee, Platform Code Committee member

Senior Software Engineer (2 years 10 months)
Working on the Jobs Search team to help members discover their next job
Helping guest users find their next job

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer (1 year 5 months)
Build end to end features for the new Lightning Report Builder page using React, Oracle SQL, and Java micro-services.

Member of Technical Staff (1 year 7 months)
Joined Reporting team on Analytics to support Core Reporting web page, Analytics mobile product, and API. Creating new end to end Lightning features.
Re-joined Salesforce1 Mobile Dashboards team to revamp old product with new charts and API-backed architecture.

Associate Member of Technical Staff (11 months)
Worked on launching scheduled Report Notifications engine to GA.
Performance and fixes for Salesforce1 Reports and Dashboard mobile.
Lead the front-end development of Lightning Analytics home team, a new list view page for Reports and Dashboards

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Merge batch scripts and manual steps to create one automated Powershell script for setting up new servers. Created an end-to-end solution for deploying patches to production servers and creating backups using the .NET framework

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Perform and analyze performance and functionality for S1 Analytics Mobile Dashboards team
Developed the Dashboard Filter Alias feature

positions.title: Mobile App Developer
positions.description:
Research and develop Mobile Applications

Developed core library integration for a smart video editing application using FFMPEG
Developed prototype for an OS-level integrated custom texting app using CCS3

projects.title: Word Learn Dictionary
projects.description:
Developer and publisher of Android Application.

A dictionary with 320,000 offline definitions and fun quiz features.
